sections.title: General Bug Fixes
sections.description: Fixed an issue where Junkrat's mythic skin could cause the game to freeze when selecting certain components.

sections.title: Stadium Bug Fixes
sections.description: Fixed an issue in Stadium where Lucio's Radio Edit power remained active even after being removed from the build loadout. This power is now available again. Fixed an issue where Winston's Salvaged Slugs mod did not reduce his ammo when using primary fire.
